s01.narration: Want to know who in your company has which laptop or phone? Hi, I'm Maria from the Sloneek team, and I'll show you how to track and hand over work assets.

s02.narration: You'll find assets in the left menu, in the Company section, where I expand Assets.

s03.narration: I click Management, and the Management of assets page opens with every asset in the company.

s04.narration: For each asset you see the holder, with the acceptance status under their name, and next to it the inventory number and category.

s05.narration: Narrow the list down with search, with the Acceptance status filter, for example to assets waiting for confirmation, or by category.

s06.narration: The switch at the top right turns on a detailed table, which you can download with the Export to Excel button.

s07.narration: I turn the switch off again, and with the Import button you can upload many assets at once from an Excel template.

s08.narration: The orange button then reminds everyone who hasn't confirmed their asset yet to accept it.

s09.narration: I click Categories in the menu, where you set up groups of assets, such as laptops or phones, that you can then filter by.

s10.narration: You create a new category with the Add button, just give it a name and a color.

s11.narration: I click Custom fields, where you add extra details, such as the manufacturer, a size or a licence expiry date.

s12.narration: Each field has its own type, for example text, number, date, a choice from options, or a reminder.

s13.narration: In the menu I click Management again, then Add, and the new asset card opens.

s14.narration: In the Name field I type what the asset is, here a Lenovo ThinkPad laptop.

s15.narration: The date of acquisition is prefilled with today, and for an older asset you simply change it.

s16.narration: The inventory number is required and must be unique within the company.

s17.narration: In Designation I enter the serial number, and if the asset doesn't have one, the lightning button generates a random code.

s18.narration: I fill in the acquisition price excluding VAT and pick euros as the currency.

s19.narration: In the Category field I tick Notebook, and with the plus button next to it you could create a new category right away.

s20.narration: With the Select button you can upload a photo of the asset, so everyone knows right away what it is.

s21.narration: I'll hand the asset over right away, so I click Assign this asset, and Holder information appears below.

s22.narration: As the holder I choose my colleague Olivia Brown.

s23.narration: I leave the asset status at New and the handover date at today.

s24.narration: In the note I write what Olivia gets with the laptop, because the note goes into the handover protocol.

s25.narration: I click Save, and the asset is created together with its holder.

s26.narration: The holder then accepts the asset in the app with an electronic signature, or rejects it, and until then it waits for confirmation.

s27.narration: If they put off accepting it, the arrow button sends them the acceptance request again.

s28.narration: I click the Expanded tab, where you fill in the custom fields you prepared earlier.

s29.narration: I click the History tab, where you'll find the handover protocols and an audit log that records every change to the asset.

s30.narration: You'll find the employee's view in the Me section of the menu, where I expand My assets and click Overview.

s301.narration: Here employees see their assets and confirm a pending handover with the Accept button.

s31.narration: In the Assets section I click Handover Protocols, where you have the signed handover and return protocols from the whole company.

s32.narration: I click Management again and open an asset the holder has already accepted, for example a company car.

s321.narration: In its detail you can request its return, which the holder signs, or return it straight to stock without a protocol.

s33.narration: You'll also find one person's assets on their user card, so in the menu I expand Users and click Management.

s331.narration: I type Brown into the search and click the name to open Olivia's card.

s332.narration: I click the Assets tab and see the laptop we just handed over to Olivia.

s34.narration: To decide who can manage assets, click Basic and work data and choose Asset manager in the Special user rights field.

s35.narration: Now you know how to track assets, hand them over to employees and look up their history, and if something doesn't work, check the Help Center.

s36.narration: Less admin, more time for people. This is Sloneek.
